lines.speaker: lenz
lines.text: The Sandman. My predecessor. I have studied your work. Elegant, but sentimental.

lines.speaker: lenz
lines.text: First Violin plays on the beat. One, two, three. Count with me.

lines.speaker: lenz
lines.text: You'll meet him at the end of the piece. If you keep tempo.
